data.narrative:
Helios is a Series A climate and energy technology company founded by Jonathan Geifman, Elad Geffen, Guy Amir, John Hausner, and Ohad Hallak. The company has raised $26M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised of $26M as a baseline value proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $52M. Peer-median analysis is not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables within the Climate & Energy peer set—while eight same-sector companies exist, none satisfy simultaneous same-stage and similar-valuation-tier filters necessary for reliable median derivation.

The triangulated valuation range is $44M to $60M, with a median of $52M, supported by the single applicable methodology. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.0x multiplier for Helios' specific technology and market position, and the absence of narrowly-filtered peer data to validate or adjust the stage-progression output. Additional comps or clarification of Helios' technical differentiation within energy hardware would strengthen confidence in this range.
